content:
nina (AE): Heads-up: FinTrust is pressing for compliance artifacts before we start their POC — they want SOC 2 Type II report, a pen-test attestation letter (scope + signatory), a sanitized network diagram, and staging IPs. Also asking if Dedicated is required to hit the SLA they need and how much extra that costs. Can someone own collating the artifacts and a presigned upload for them?

sam (SE): I can own the artifact package and pricing delta. Quick questions: do they need the full SOC 2 report or just the attestation and control summary? We usually share report via dataroom after NDA.

maria (Security): We do not hand out raw pen-test reports publicly. Our standard practice: provide a signed pen-test attestation letter that summarizes scope, date, and that a vetted 3rd-party performed the test; full report goes to the customer via secure dataroom under NDA. We can also sanitize a network diagram. For staging IPs — we can provide ephemeral CIDR ranges for the POC; requires staging VPC mapping and an ingress rule request.

nina (AE): Customer asked for a presigned upload link to drop some internal docs into our dataroom (they prefer dropping rather than email). Can we provide an S3 presigned PUT with 72h expiry and single-object permissions? Need to confirm ACL and encryption-at-rest.

sam (SE): Yes. We create a one-time presigned upload tied to their dataroom folder, expiry 72h, server-side SSE, and no public-read. I can provision and paste placeholder link once dataroom is created. Sample upload curl I usually share:

```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/pdf" --data-binary @evidence.pdf
```

sam (SE): I'll also prep a checklist: SOC2 attestation (pdf), pen-test attestation (pdf), sanitized network diagram (png/svg), staging IPs & VPC mapping (txt), contact for pen-test signatory. ETA: EOD tomorrow for the bundle and pricing delta.

maria (Security): Note for pen-test letter: scope should explicitly mention "inference API endpoints (hosted)" and whether Dedicated/On-prem components are in-scope. If FinTrust wants Dedicated in-scope we need to involve infra and that changes lead time and pricing. Also legal sign-off needed for sharing attestation to customer (standard).

deploy-bot: New secure dataroom created: DR-4412 (internal link hidden). Access: nina, sam, maria. API: presigned uploads enabled.

sam (SE): Perfect. I'll upload artifacts to DR-4412 and generate the presigned PUT for FinTrust after we confirm NDA. Nina, can you confirm who at FinTrust will sign the NDA and pen-test letter (name + title)?

nina (AE): I'll ask them now and update in this thread. Also cc'ing legal if they need a templated NDA. :thumbsup:

maria (Security): One more FYI — if they request copies of vulnerability findings, we only provide high-level remediation summaries. Full vuln reports require a redacted release process and legal review.

nina (AE): Got it. Thanks team. Will report back with signatory and NDA timeline.
